paragraphs: The University of Victoria (UVic) is a public research university in Victoria, British Columbia, founded in 1963. Consistently ranked among Canada's top research universities, UVic serves over 22,000 students and is internationally recognised for programs in engineering, business (Gustavson School), law, environmental science, and health informatics.

UVic is particularly known for its outstanding cooperative education (co-op) program — one of the largest in Canada — with strong industry partnerships across technology, government, healthcare, and the clean energy sector. UVic's co-op program enables students to gain significant paid work experience during their degree.

Victoria is consistently rated as one of Canada's most liveable cities, with a mild climate, spectacular natural setting, and strong knowledge economy. BC's capital city hosts a significant technology sector and federal government presence, providing graduates with excellent employment prospects.

International students at UVic benefit from the university's English Language Centre, extensive international student support, and access to BC's Provincial Nominee Program. Graduates qualify for the Post-Graduation Work Permit and BC's immigration pathways.
paragraphsRu: University of Victoria (UVic) — государственный исследовательский университет в Виктории, Британская Колумбия, основан в 1963 году. Постоянно занимает ведущие позиции среди лучших исследовательских университетов Канады. Более 22 000 студентов.
UVic особенно известен выдающейся программой кооперативного образования (co-op) — одной из крупнейших в Канаде — с сильными партнёрствами в технологиях, правительстве и здравоохранении.
Виктория постоянно признаётся одним из самых пригодных для жизни городов Канады с мягким климатом и развитым технологическим сектором.
Иностранные студенты UVic имеют право на Post-Graduation Work Permit и BC Provincial Nominee Program.
